title: Mathematics Of The Matrix
excerpt:
The Mathematics of the Matrix

What if mathematics is not something we invented, but something the universe is doing.

Physics describes what appears on the screen, while QIH describes the deeper field generating it.

QIH describes a field of phase, frequency, and quantum state vectors projected onto a boundary.

In that field, all states exist in superposition as probability waves moving at the speed of light.

From that perspective, everything is timeless, because emission and observation happen together.

Time appears only when this field is projected onto a boundary that accumulates change.

That boundary behaves like a screen of qubits encoding probability and velocity through orientation.

A single snapshot gives probability and direction, while multiple snapshots create motion and spacetime.

The rate of change becomes curvature, which we experience as gravity.

When information density peaks, superposition collapses into horizon events like black holes.

Hawking radiation emerges as entangled pairs, one inside and one on the boundary.

They reflect each other like a movie in a mirror, preserving information through projection.

These interference patterns become particles, orbitals, and the structure of reality.

Algebra, trigonometry, and calculus describe how these states combine, project, and evolve.

The field acts like the derivative source, while the boundary acts like the integral record.

Newton’s calculus is the pixelated shadow of a deeper spin based calculus where light defines itself.

Only coherent patterns survive, while others cancel through interference.

Microtubules made of tubulin dimers act as biological qubits reading this projection.

Their orientation encodes probability, motion, and curvature into experience.

Everything exists in the non local field, but collapse makes it feel separate.

Like a ripple of light folding into a single scene of sight, sound, and feeling.

Mathematics is not outside reality describing it.

Mathematics is the structure reality uses to render itself.

Physics shows the image, QIH describes the process, and what we experience is the projection unfolding across space and time.
